name: BANKSY niches
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Tissue niches from each cell's expression and its neighbourhood's, imported from the authors' own BANKSY package.
long_description: Runs BANKSY (Singhal et al., Nat Genet 2024) with the authors' published Python package, pybanksy, imported as they ship it, with no method code of its own. It joins every cell's expression to that of its spatial neighbours and clusters the result into niches with Leiden. The niches are painted on the map, with their cell types, marker genes and a downloadable list of every cell's niche.
citation: Singhal V, Chou N, Lee J, et al. BANKSY unifies cell typing and tissue domain segmentation for scalable spatial omics data analysis. Nat Genet 56, 431-441 (2024).

params.name: lambda_param
params.label: Neighbourhood weight (lambda)
params.help:
How much a cell's neighbourhood counts against its own expression (pybanksy's lambda).
The authors use 0.8 for tissue domains and 0.2 for spatially informed cell types; 0 ignores space.

params.name: k_geom
params.label: Spatial neighbours (k_geom)
params.help: How many nearest cells make a neighbourhood. The authors' default is 15, for single cells.

params.name: max_m
params.label: AGF order (max_m)
params.help:
1 adds BANKSY's azimuthal Gabor filter, over twice the neighbours: it responds where expression changes across a neighbourhood, as at a border. It is the authors' recommended default.
0 uses the neighbourhood's mean alone, and a third less memory.

params.name: nbr_weight_decay
params.label: Neighbour weights
params.help: How a neighbour's weight falls with its distance.

params.name: zscore_by
params.label: Z-score
params.help:
Sets over which cells each gene is z-scored when a run holds several sections. It changes nothing on one section.
Per section evens out differences in a gene's overall level between sections, which suits replicates of one tissue. Across all sections keeps them, which suits sections of different tissues.

params.name: pca_dims
params.label: Principal components (pca_dims)
params.help: How many components of the BANKSY matrix the clustering sees. The authors' default is 20.

params.name: resolution
params.label: Leiden resolution
params.help:
Higher values give more, smaller niches; lower values give fewer, larger ones.
0.7 is the authors' default. Not used when Number of niches is set.

params.name: max_labels
params.label: Number of niches (max_labels)
params.help: 0 goes by the resolution. Any other number has pybanksy search for a resolution that gives that many niches, up to 25 tries of Leiden, so it takes longer and may stop short.

params.name: num_nn
params.label: Expression neighbours (num_nn)
params.help: How many neighbours each cell has in the graph Leiden partitions, in the space of the principal components. The authors use 50.

params.name: n_top_genes
params.label: Variable genes (n_top_genes)
params.help:
How many of the most variable genes to use. The authors use 2000.
Time and memory grow in proportion.

params.name: refine_iterations
params.label: Label refinement (iterations)
params.help:
How many times a cell takes the label of most of its 6 nearest cells. 0 is off.
The authors offer it for domain segmentation, and warn against excess: it wears out fine domains.
